title: Vibr - A Deep Idle/Incremental Game About Vibe Coding
author: Scubagerber
selftext:
Hi everyone !

https://preview.redd.it/rbxae8akks1h1.png?width=1376&format=png&auto=webp&s=3fe12efc06a3337baac7e8022fbdf940828f25a5

I made Vibr, an idle game where you research/build/manage AI products. Mash the keyboard to mint code, cascade up into products, ship things. There's a twist at the end I won't spoil.

Cascade: Characters -> Files -> Software Engineering (SWE) Patterns -> Components -> Modules -> Products

[Game Interface: Queuing the Game AI Training Job](https://preview.redd.it/hmd44o2ocs1h1.png?width=1917&format=png&auto=webp&s=a56d457f406fb7bf4d5bc3adaa551936c40f34f9)

In beta, late-game is built, but balance is still a work in progress. I've ironed out the first half through playtesting that I've been able to make up to Phase 2 (First 5 Products) into a Demo.

The Game AI Agent (Think Dota Bot) is your first product, it generates Research Points for the Tech Tree.

Then you make a Base LLM API, that creates Raw Text Tokens for the other 3:

Companion Chat (Dangerous Tokens)  
Chatbot (Slop Tokens)  
Coding Buddy (Quality Tokens)

You won't manually type the code forever, after your first Prestige, you can afford the AI Assistant who will begin coding with you. As you level it up, it begins to take over that for you.

Play the Demo: [vibr.aiascent.game](https://vibr.aiascent.game) (browser, no signup required)

Steam: Coming Soon™

Quick context on how this got made (Rule 4). When Gemini 2.5 Pro dropped in March 2025 (first model with thinking + 1M context that could actually write code), I went deep. Spent 4 months building the underlying AI-startup sim. 

I manually wrangled a 47,000 line master\_content.txt that wrapped the entire project (988 cycles, 130+ tracked artifacts) and fed it wholesale into Gemini every cycle. 

Just Notepad++ + Gemini + WinMerge to apply diffs.

For tricky cycles I'd send the same prompt to multiple Gemini instances in parallel and pick the best response as the base for the next one.

This was before Claude Code, before Cursor's agent mode, before "vibe coding" was a phrase.

Stopped working on the project for some months (switched to others, including making my own Data Curation Environment ( [https://aiascent.dev/](https://aiascent.dev/) ) based on the emergent structure of \`master\_content.txt\`, then, more recently, I came back after learning how to use Claude Code and in 10 days, re-imagined the original [https://aiascent.game/](https://aiascent.game/) into [https://vibr.aiascent.game/](https://vibr.aiascent.game/)

Feedback explicitly welcome.
